title: The Pale Harvest
journal: Nesh-Deeka sent me to the wreck of the Pale Harvest in Hatandros Bight, a short swim out from Ysan's jetty. I'm to get into the hold, where the drowned crew walk, and open the captain's strongbox. I may fight them or steal past and pick its lock; the captain carries its key.
objectives: Open the captain's strongbox in the wreck of the Pale Harvest. (marker: Captain's Strongbox, Drowned Captain, Ysan Jetty)

plan.going: The silver setting named the Pale Harvest, a wreck that may hold the next clue to the Eye.
plan.next: Travel by boat to Thorn, walk to Ysan's jetty, swim to the wreck and open the captain's strongbox.
plan.ways: Fight the drowned crew and take the captain's key, or sneak past them and pick the strongbox's Adept lock.
terms: Hatandros Bight and Ysan: journal 10: the bay, and the landing with the stone jetty

answers: I work for handler Nesh-Deeka of the Toh-Reel-Ka. I am hunting the real Eye of Argonia, which is meant to heal the Hist trees at the Root. The Old Silver Setting led me to the wreck of the Pale Harvest, a Company freighter in Hatandros Bight. The Unbound and the Collector (Ennodius Vanin) are also after the Eye.
Get into the wreck, past the drowned crew, and open the captain's strongbox.
Fight the Drowned Captain and Drowned Sailor and take the key from the captain, or sneak past and pick the strongbox lock. I favour fighting.
I do not know what the strongbox holds, or why the crew are drowned and walking. I could find out by looking inside the wreck.

title: The Pale Harvest
journal: In the captain's strongbox lay a keystone on a chain, carved in a style I do not know. I'm to bring it to Nesh-Deeka in her house in Helstrom.
objectives: Bring the keystone to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom. (marker: Nesh-Deeka)

plan.going: I have a keystone from the wreck; I do not know what it opens.
plan.next: Bring it to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom, by boat back up the rivers.

answers: I killed the Drowned Captain, took his key and opened the strongbox on the Pale Harvest. It held a Kothringi Keystone on a chain. It is a lead toward the real Eye, for Nesh-Deeka.
Take the keystone to Nesh-Deeka in her house in Helstrom.
I can go straight there. I could also look over the rest of the wreck first, but the journal only points me to Nesh-Deeka.
I do not know what Kothringi means, or what the keystone does. Nesh-Deeka may tell me.

title: The Pale Harvest
journal: Nesh-Deeka did not know the keystone, but it is of Kothringi make, and the Chime-Keepers of Toklea keep what is left of Kothringi lore. She already knew the Unbound had not found the wreck. When I asked how, she said "we listen" and talked of Toklea instead. She paid me 100 gold.

plan.going: The keystone is Kothringi; the Chime-Keepers of Toklea may know what it opens. Nesh-Deeka again knew where the Unbound had or had not been.
plan.next: MN08 starts; its first entry marks Toklea.
terms: Kothringi: Nesh-Deeka: the silver-skinned people of the marsh, dead of the Knahaten Flu
the Chime-Keepers of Toklea: Nesh-Deeka: the town that keeps Kothringi lore

answers: The quest is done. I got the Kothringi Keystone from the Pale Harvest and gave it to Nesh-Deeka. She did not know it, but she says it is Kothringi make. She paid me 100 gold (the game shows it added twice). She says the Unbound have not been to the wreck, but she would not say how she knows: "we listen."
The next lead is Toklea, on the river fork in the Tulmek Washes. The Chime-Keepers there keep Kothringi lore and their elder should know the keystone.
I can go to Toklea. I can also ask Nesh-Deeka about the Kothringi and the Chime-Keepers first.
I do not know who the Kothringi were, what the keystone opens, or how Nesh-Deeka knows what the Unbound do. I can ask her the Kothringi and Chime-Keepers topics, or ask the elder in Toklea.
